description: The image displays three pie charts illustrating the distribution of quantifiers and operations across different reasoning categories. The first chart, titled "Categorical," shows four segments: "Universal Quantifiers" at 29.07% (light blue), "Negation" at 27.91% (orange), "Limiter" at 27.91% (light pink), and "Existential Quantifiers" at 15.12% (light green). The second chart, "Approximate Number Generation," presents three segments: "Approximate Quantities" at 45.03% (beige), "Comparative Relationships" at 36.26% (light blue), and "Absolute Absence" at 18.71% (light purple). The third chart, "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal segments: "Disjunctive" at 49.51% (light lavender) and "Conjunctive" at 50.49% (darker lavender). Each segment in the charts is labeled with its category name and percentage value, and the overall layout compares the relative proportions of these elements within each reasoning domain.
